author: Johnny Harris
description:
Why does China LOOK like that??

Check out all my sources for this video here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1oKwCAIWRcIDCcZUFzaw6DSwXHJKlwQ_G9B5nclKaVv0/edit?usp=sharing

China can BUILD. Their infrastructure is incredible. And I always figured that was because they're basically a dictatorship: what the leader says, goes. But the real reason turned out to be way more interesting.
